decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-54 MODIFY capturing the brand colors, cross-location branding consistency, and national positioning; the visual-design Event requires no additional state change.
Mobile-friendly behavior is already established by the candidate's message-54 INTRODUCE and is not additionally changed by the source visual-style update.
The candidate's message-54 INTRODUCE already captures dedicated location pages and consistent cross-location design and branding.
The source visual-design changes do not alter location-selection or routing semantics, which already have their own message-54 MODIFY.
The candidate's message-54 MODIFY already captures the national scope and positioning; the visual-design update does not change the master site's functional role.
The candidate already has a message-54 MODIFY stating that future locations can be added without redesign, and no further template-state change is necessary.
Homepage section composition is independently and completely established by its message-54 INTRODUCE; the visual-style update does not alter the section list.

Cross-location visual consistency does not alter the required isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, accounts, or reporting.
